notes:
Quick CRM notes / call highlights:
- Company: Banyan Inkworks Systems — marketing automation platform for SMB publishers and agencies. High-volume campaign generator + churn of campaign variants.
- Traffic estimate: ~8-12M tokens/month now, could grow 3x in 6 months. Typical request size 50-300 tokens. Peak bursts 150-200 req/s during campaigns.
- Primary asked: hosted (self-serve) API for fast onboarding. Cost is a major constraint — they asked about per-token unit economics and billing visibility.
- Performance targets: tail latency for short prompts <300ms, steady-state throughput ~150 req/s, allow spikes to 200 req/s.
- Model preference: flexible to use curated open models; want lower-cost quantized variants for bulk generation and higher-quality variant for customer-facing preview.
- Ops interest: automatic prefix/KV caching, request batching, and suggestion of quantization profiles. Wants guidance from Redwood Optimize on batching config.
- Security: require SSO (SAML) for admin users, SOC2 is expected; audit logs required for first release. Data residency not strict but legal wants confirmation on logs retention + purge APIs.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable cost and per-token visibility — can't have bills swing month-to-month during a campaign."
- AE notes: good fit for Hosted API self-serve; likely SMB ARR band but potential to expand to Dedicated once throughput and cost stabilize.
- Risks: internal budget cycle in late Mar; legal review could add 3-4 weeks.
- POC ask: 1-week throughput run with sample campaign dataset, include burst scenario, include cost projection and caching/batching config recommendations.
requirements_summary: SMB marketing platform needs hosted API. Key asks: predictable per-token pricing, token-level cost & latency dashboards, automatic prefix caching and batching recommendations, ability to pin model variants for preview vs bulk generation, SSO for admin, SOC2 + audit logging. POC to validate throughput and unit economics.
